mission: Keep CYNIC from adding organs onto an unstable body by turning audit facts into explicit guard decisions and repair queues.

trust_model.declared: A directory or manifest exists, but the body must not rely on it.
trust_model.wired: Desired state, runbook, controller, and SSOT exist.
trust_model.alive: Declared runtime outputs exist and are fresh or warm.
trust_model.useful: The organ produces downstream work products consumed by another organ or operator.
trust_model.trusted: The organ is wired, alive, useful, and has explicit manual gates for dangerous actions.

guard_rules.rule: Do not create a new organ when an existing organ owns the domain but is missing contract or runtime evidence.
Do not treat production_organ as trusted unless runtime_status is live or warm.
Manifest-only organs are declarations, not autonomous body parts.
Personal workstation kernel downtime must degrade to durable queues, not stop edge capture or bounty workflow.
No GitHub issue, PR, Discord post, or external claim can be made without explicit human approval.
